scripts.check: npm run openwa:server:verify && npm run contract:check && npm run check:connector && npm run check:runtime && npm run check:studio
scripts.contract:generate: npm -w @wa/runtime run contract:generate && npm -w @wa/runtime-contract run generate
scripts.contract:check: npm run contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/runtime-contract
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run release:manifest && npm run sidecar:prepare
scripts.dev: npm run desktop:prepare && npm -w @wa/studio run tauri -- dev
scripts.build:desktop: npm run desktop:prepare && npm -w @wa/studio run tauri -- build
scripts.check:release: npm run check:security && node tooling/test-openwa-server-release.mjs && npm run openwa:server:verify && node tooling/release/test-build-updater-release.mjs && node tooling/release/test-updater-release.mjs && npm run release:manifest:check
scripts.test:integration: npm -w @wa/runtime run test:integration && npm -w @wa/runtime run event-inbox:e2e
